messages:
sam (Marketing): Quick sync — planning to publish release note + launch post Thu 09:00 UTC. Need final changelog permalink, docs link, and a go/no-go from eng. Also need the benchmark PNG for the blog.

eric (Eng): we'll give go/no-go by Wed 18:00 UTC. Canary plan: EU first, 15m canary at 5% traffic, then ramp to 50% at 09:40, full at 10:15.

tara (Product): Can we keep embargo until publish? Marketing wants to schedule social cards.

mike (Docs): Docs are nearly done, PR incoming now: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/499. Permalink will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/3.2.1 once merged.

paula (Growth): Scheduling email + social for 09:10 UTC contingent on canary health. Also need CRM tags to route webinar signups vs enterprise interest.

eric (Eng): Short changelog for headline: "Reduced median latency, improved batching cache, and new quantization presets for cost savings." Full changelog: https://changelogs.internal/3.2.1.

sam (Marketing): Nice. Can we get p50/p95 and a 1-line bench note for the blog? e.g., "p95 under 150ms on typical workloads"?

eric (Eng): For the benchmark slide: p50=38ms, p95=140ms, throughput per-GPU (single req)=2.1k tokens/s, with batching peak=6.8k tokens/s. You can use p95 < 150ms. I'll upload CSV + PNG.

ops-bot: [deploy-scheduler] Release reservation created Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC. Canary window 09:00-09:15 UTC.

tara (Product): Request: keep rollback achievable within 4 minutes. Also prefer partial rollback to canary if anomaly during ramp.

eric (Eng): Agreed. Runbook thresholds: error-rate > 0.8% -> pause; error-rate > 1.5% -> rollback. p95 > 300ms -> investigate; KV-cache-hit < 60% -> rollback. I'll paste the runbook snippet here shortly.

mike (Docs): PR opened and linked in the release checklist. Will add an API example for the new quantization flag.

paula (Growth): For lead routing: webinar signups -> Growth inbox, set tag "source:launch-webinar"; demo requests -> Solutions, tag "lead:product-interest". For enterprise-size leads (>50 seats) add label "enterprise-opportunity".

eric (Eng): Canary checklist (paste):
```
- confirm all model variants loaded
- KV cache warmup 20m
- start at 5% traffic Canary (09:00-09:15)
- monitor p95 < 250ms, error-rate < 0.8%
- healthcheck endpoints green for 2 consecutive intervals
- rollback to previous model if error-rate spike > 1.5%
```

sam (Marketing): Thanks. I'll hold the social schedule until docs permalink and a positive canary report. Also need the benchmark PNG by EOD for the blog header.

mike (Docs): PNG + small caption uploaded to the PR assets. Permalink confirmed after merge.

eric (Eng): I'll post a short canary status update in this thread at 09:20 and a full rollout confirmation at 10:30.

paula (Growth): Email queued with merge-check condition and canary OK check. If both pass, sends at 09:20.

sam (Marketing): Great. Final ask: marketing needs the one-paragraph webinar blurb for the registration page. @tara can you draft?

tara (Product): Draft: "Join our engineers and product team to see the 3.2.1 performance improvements, live demos of migration tips, and a walkthrough of cost-saving settings. Q&A follows." Use that and I'll refine.

sam (Marketing): Perfect. I'll draft the final blog and schedule everything after the canary update. :rocket:
